definitions.short: Kirjath-Sannah or Kirjath-Sepher , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H7158. Qiryath Sannah or Qiryath Sepher קִרְיַתסֵֿ֫פֶר proper name, of a location πόλις ( τῶν ) γραμμάτων , + ( ᵐ5 B Judg 1:11 ) Καριασσωφαρ : ancient name of דְּבִיר (see II. ׳ד 2c ) (perhaps סֹֿפֵר׳ק scribe-town , compare ᵐ5 above also ᵑ6 and Egyptian Bai-ti¾u-pa-ïra , house of scribe , WMM As.u.Eur.174 Buhl Geogr.274 , compare GFM Ju ); — Josh 15:15-16 , Judg 1:11-12 , another name is סַֿנָּה׳ק Josh 15:49 (but ᵐ5 πόλις γραμμάτων , hence read perhaps סֿפר׳ק , so Steuern), in southern Judah; on site (probably Dhoherîye , 5 hours southwest from Hebron) see II. דְּבִיר 2c and Buhl Geogr.164 .
definitions.rootNote: or קִרְיַת סֵפֶר ; from 7151 and a simpler feminine from the same as 5577 , or (for the latter name) 5612 ; city of branches, or of a book;
